user.title: Haikubox Setup
user.description: Before you start: your Haikubox must be publicly shareable. Sign in at {listen_url}, turn on the "Share your haikubox with friends" setting, and copy the serial from the public URL the site then displays.

data_description.serial: Hexadecimal code; length varies by model (e.g. 100000003d7c9f2b). Read it from your box's public URL, or its base on units that have a serial sticker.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Haikubox
reconfigure.description: Update the serial number for your Haikubox.

data_description.serial: The serial code for your Haikubox device

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Haikubox API. Check that the serial is correct and that you've enabled "Share your haikubox with friends" at {listen_url}.

init.title: Haikubox options
init.description: Tune what counts as “notable.” Higher values favour rare species (stable, low-churn list). Lower values favour recent detections (dynamic, more turnover). Recency is measured over the trailing 24 hours.

data_description.notable_rarity_weight: 100% = pure rarity; 0% = pure recency. Default 70% leans toward rarity with a small recency nudge.
